name: mirage
text: Lag audit so far: I can't see a cause in the data you sent. Your 15:22 report had no screen-frame numbers (they sat after a section that got cut), a 10.4 s cold start, an 8 MB bets file (fixed in v1.0.123), and Battery Saver ON, which slows the app. I'm moving the frame numbers to the top of the report so the next one shows what lags. After v1.0.123 settles, send one fresh report right after you scroll and type for a minute. I'll fix whatever it names.
